methods.name: Multiscale Spatial Context-Guided Network (MSCG-Net)
methods.summary: MSCG-Net is a dual-branch architecture for landslide detection that integrates a CNN-based branch for local spatial detail extraction and an omnidirectional multi-scale Mamba (OMM) branch for global contextual dependency modeling. It features an Adaptive Feature Enhancement Module (AFEM) to fuse these branches and an omnidirectional multiscale scanning (OMSS) mechanism to improve contextual modeling.

availability.author_statement: Data availability statement present with shared links.

reproducibility_assessment: The landslide inventory datasets are referenced and linked, but the custom code for the MSCG-Net method is not available.
